summary: Operator site behind a Cloudflare challenge (unreadable); used the operator's Campspot booking page and park record (legal name 'Northern Exposure Inc, a Michigan Non-Profit Corporation, d/b/a Northern Exposure Campground'). Sewer true -> false (park rules: grey/black water to dump stations only); max rig 40 -> 60 (Campspot site types; waterfront sites 40); pull-through, showers, dump, general store added; booking url set to the operator's /book/ page. Fees left at the October 2026 $28 Campspot rate (+$5 reservation surcharge per stay): next season isn't open for booking, so no summer rate could be read. 91 RV sites bookable online against the 260 recorded (not stated by the operator; left). No gateway within 40 km (Sleeping Bear Dunes 53 km); the family has not stayed here. Phone (231) 885-1199 matches.
flags: Website: the second link is a misspelled Campspot marketplace slug (https://www.campspot.com/park/norther-exposure-campground); the operator's own booking page is https://www.campspot.com/book/northernexposureinc. northernexposureinc.com sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (403 to plain HTTP and to the headless browser, 2026-10-22), so its content could not be checked.

Price gate: the only 2026 rate read is $28/night in October (Campspot, 2026-10-13); a directory (CamplinQ, 2024) calls fall rates after Labor Day 'from $25'. The summer rate is unknown until next season opens for booking; RV Life $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km.

Seasonal share not published: Campspot books 91 RV sites online against the 260 sites recorded (from an old note, not the operator); if the 260 is right, roughly a third are sold nightly online. The operator site that might say more is unreadable.
